fields.id: NNN, zero-padded, assigned in order and never reused
fields.title: short noun phrase
fields.status: one of: confirmed | refuted | superseded | open | retracted
fields.claim: ONE sentence. If it cannot be said in one sentence it is more than one finding.
fields.evidence: the numbers, with intervals where they exist. Never a bare point estimate for a comparison.
fields.method: how it was measured, including the split. A number without its split is not a result.
fields.provenance: slurm job ids, script paths, data paths -- enough to rerun it
fields.caveats: what would make this wrong, and what it does NOT say
fields.date: ISO date the finding reached its current status

rules: A refuted finding is NEVER deleted. The refutation is the valuable part -- it stops the idea being retried.
Every comparison carries its uncertainty. 'X beats Y' without an interval is not a finding.
Every accuracy carries the majority-class rate. Every AUC carries its split.
If a claim was selected on the data it is reported against, say so in caveats.
Filenames are NNN-<slug>.yaml where slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+','-', title.lower()).strip('-')[:55]. Titles containing '/' silently became directory paths before this was written down.
